capacity.description: The capacity in which the founder converts.

class_account_id.description: The class: its share-capital account, 3010 ordinary or 3020 preference.

difference_account_id.description: Under fair value: the profit-or-loss account the difference goes to.

fair_value_price.description: Under fair value: the shares' fair value per share.

measurement.description: The measurement basis the accountant picks: the carrying amount (the default) or the shares' fair value with the difference in profit or loss.

note.description: Under fair value: the accountant's note on the basis.
examples: Measured at the seed round's price, as the founder converts as a lender

price.description: The price per share in the base currency, a decimal string with at most 6 decimals.

price_basis.description: Where the price comes from: the latest priced round, an independent valuation, or a price every shareholder approves. Left out, the setting founders.price_basis.
